(39)e ho ho snyigs ma'i chos gzugs dang*/chos brgyad kyi mgo bo bskor bskor nas/byang chub kyi lam la yid re rmongs/phyin drug gi nyams len lhod

tei:div.tei:p: (39)e ho ho snyigs ma'i chos gzugs dang*/ chos brgyad kyi mgo bo bskor bskor nas/ byang chub kyi lam la yid re rmongs/ phyin drug gi nyams len lhod por song*/ pha thugs rjes gzigs shig rin po che/ bu'i da dung 'khrul pa'i dbang du shor/ chos rjogs pa chen po go yul lus/ lam nyams len zab mo rgyang du dor/ tshe 'di yi snang shas dang du blang*/ lam log pa bdag la brtse bas dgongs/ nga kun mkhyen brgyud pa'i grwar skyes kyang*/ rgyud dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa nyung*/ nga bsam zhing rang la skyo ba 'phel/ sems skyo ba'i snying rlung gting nas lang*/ tshe 'di yi snang shes skyur snying 'dod/ bzang 'dod kyi 'gong po bkar snying 'dod/ grags 'dod kyi bzang brdzu 'dis su ma phan/ sems chos dang mthun par byin gyis rlobs/ pha thugs rje can gyi dgongs mjod dang*/ bu tul ba'i snang tshul 'di 'dra (40)lags/ gnas dben pa zhig la nam phyin snyams/ 'khor slob ma'i ching thag bcad snying 'dod/ chos yin lo 'di 'khrul pa che shos go dgon gog po 'di bdud kyi zhags pa shes/ ngas byas tshad 'di 'khor ba'i snon mar gda'/ bu'i bsam blo 'di 'grub pa bla mas mkhyen/ bar chad med pa zhig khyed la re/ gegs med du 'grub pa'i mthun 'gyur zhu/ ri shwa rlung khyer bzhin du bkra shis shog
